ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
benefits_summary: ₹15,000 toolkit e-voucher, skill training with ₹500/day stipend, and collateral-free enterprise loans up to ₹3,00,000 at 5% concessional interest.
exclusions: Government employees and their family members
Applicants who already availed PMEGP or Mudra loans in the last 5 years
application_steps: Visit your nearest Common Service Centre (CSC) to register on the PM Vishwakarma portal.
Complete three-stage verification by Gram Panchayat/ULB and District Committee.
Receive your PM Vishwakarma Digital ID and apply for toolkit incentive and credit.
